inspiration: Hunt-creature marker, category level: a rare roaming creature gets a translucent outline and a short name tag, drawn at both the minimap and the main view (plugins/.../implings/Implings.kt, lines 38, 54, 63). Recreate the marker with our own silhouette and tag style.
Chat shortcodes to sprites: a list of short names maps to a single emoji sheet (emojis/names.csv, emojis/emojis.png). Recreate as a text-to-sprite chat set with our own art and our own names.

Low-detail mode as a player toggle for weak devices: plugins lowdetail, flatshading and fpsthrottle are named as toggles (folder names only, lowdetail/README.md present, not opened). Recreate as one visible low-detail switch for our 375 wide play, with our own settings.
Visible frame throttle as a setting: fpsthrottle is a named plugin (folder only, not opened). Recreate as a throttle option on the settings screen, with our own numbers.

briefs.label: hunt-creature tag (own label, category level)
briefs.why: A small target with an outline and a name tag is readable at 375 wide. One signature behaviour: it wanders off and returns. One signature sound: a short chime on sight. Could be ours at 20-30 percent resemblance.
briefs.keep: outline plus name tag at both the minimap and the main view
briefs.change: our own silhouette, our own tag style and no outline on the minimap. Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy; restricted donor, shape only

briefs.label: shortcode chat sprite set (own label)
briefs.why: Short names typed in chat become small pictures that read at 375 wide. One signature trait: a shared sheet with a name list. Could be ours at 20-30 percent resemblance. Category level only
briefs.keep: a single sheet plus a name list, so one table drives all the pictures
briefs.change: our own sheet, our own names, our own set of picture themes. Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy

briefs.label: low-detail switch (own label)
briefs.why: A single switch that cuts visual cost helps weak phones and reads as a clean settings choice. One signature behaviour: flat shading when on. Could be ours at 20-30 percent resemblance
briefs.change: our own flat-shading style and our own cut list. Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy
briefs.ref: plugins/src/main/java/org/runestar/client/plugins/lowdetail/ and flatshading/ (folder names only; README present)
